help.short: A unique file path for the volume. Used when creating mount targets. This needs to be unique within the elastic capacity pool.

description: Check if an Elastic Volume file path is available within the given Elastic Capacity Pool.

operations.description: Check if an Elastic Volume file path is available within the given Elastic Capacity Pool.

schema.description: File path availability request content - availability is based on the elastic volume filePath within the given elastic capacityPool.
schema.name: body

props.description: A unique file path for the volume. Used when creating mount targets. This needs to be unique within the elastic capacity pool.
props.name: filePath

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: True indicates name is valid and available. False indicates the name is invalid, unavailable, or both.
props.name: isAvailable

props.description: If reason == invalid, provide the user with the reason why the given name is invalid, and provide the resource naming requirements so that the user can select a valid name. If reason == AlreadyExists, explain that resource name is already in use, and direct them to select a different name.
props.name: message

props.description: Invalid indicates the name provided does not match Azure NetApp Files naming requirements. AlreadyExists indicates that the name is already in use and is therefore unavailable.
props.name: reason
